title: Live: Zelensky says he won't sign 'weak' peace deal that would only prolong Ukraine war
summary: Speaking in a New Year address to the nation, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said that his country wanted the nearly four-year war with Russia to end – but not at any cost. "My signature will be placed on a strong agreement," he said, adding that signatures "placed on weak agreements only fuel the war". Follow our liveblog for all the latest develop…
